name: smwmusic-jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-stardust-crusaders-rise-of-the-stands-stand-proud-remix
title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders - Rise of the Stands ~ Stand Proud (Remix)
description:
𝗬𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗬𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘇𝗲!

Did an arrangement of Stand Proud from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 3 for C3 Winter 2021. Did this one for a friend and really wanted to hammer in an OP theme once again. Did Chase and Bloody Stream before, and it'd be wrong if I didn't do the one from the most memed Jojo part.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. A# Minor (Custom 1 Pitch)
2. B Minor (Custom 2 Pitch)
